My Lovely Panda

A Story by Huahua

Cover

Introduction

Hello everyone!

My name is Huahua.
I am seven years old.

1

The Story Begins

Today, I want to tell you a story
about a very special animal.

2

Can You Guess?

It is black and white.
It is cute and funny.

Can you guess what it is?

3

The Answer

Yes! It is a panda!

4

National Treasure

Pandas are China's national treasure.

5

So Cute!

They have round faces,
black ears, and big black eyes.
They also have chubby bodies.

6

Look!

They are black and white,
just like they are wearing a
little black-and-white coat!

7

Home & Food

Pandas live in China.
They love bamboo very much.

8

Eat & Sleep

When they wake up, they eat bamboo.
When they are hungry, they eat bamboo.
And after eating... they take a nap!

9

Favorite Things

Eating and sleeping
are their favorite things!

10

Friends of China

They are also special friends of China.
Many people from all over the world
love pandas.

11

Think of China

When they see a panda,
they think of China.

12

Beautiful Country

They show people that China has
lovely animals,
beautiful mountains,
and wonderful culture.

13

Love & Home

I love pandas because they are
cute and friendly.
I love China because it is my
beautiful home.

14

My Hope

I hope more and more people
will love pandas,
love nature,
and learn more about China.

15

Friendship

Pandas are little friends from China.
They bring friendship from China
to the world.

16

Proud

I am proud of our pandas.
I am proud of China!

17

The End

Thank you everyone!
